capture_groups: 2026-10-28 operator positive-human hit newest capture; paired PRIVATE raw/summary; 8 persistent candidates

evidence.observed_behavior: Four relative offsets appeared in latest actual positive-human hit under overlapping minimap visual effects; not source game ball XYZ. Across the newest 3 PRE, 2 POST, 3 SETTLED samples, eight unique absolute words changed persistently; some are pointer-shaped and all were assigned visual_effect_confound family. The S002 audit showed human_contact_yes=true, human_green_yes=false, no semantic verification, maximum sampled bracket span 22 frames. C01..C08 are study-local IDs, NOT stable registry IDs. | CROSS-RUN 2026-10-28: Operator cross-run analysis of 11 S002 validated human-contact=yes captures: 13 distinct alias signature groups were found in 10/11 runs each (not necessarily the SAME missing run). Per-shot candidate counts were 8,13,13,19,45,13,9,13,45,45,45. One human_green_yes=true and ten human_green_yes=false in S002 *boolean projection*, but false can mean human-label NO OR UNKNOWN; must inspect original exact labels before defining off-green. The latest no-green-yes capture lacks five 10/11 minimap_ball_effect +0x1EC..0x1FC recurring words but contains other 10/11 signatures, demonstrating differing missing runs. All sample brackets max 22 guest frames; no no-contact control, no verified physics or trainable label. | Human-outcome-stratified operator audit of 11 exact S002 validated human-contact-positive shots: green YES=1, green NO=10, UNKNOWN=0, 47 distinct source-relative alias signatures; all 13 patterns seen in 10/11 occurred in the YES shot (1/1) and 9 of 10 NO shots (9/10); these high-recurrence minimap signatures do NOT distinguish landed-on-green outcome in this sample. Source effect aliases may overlap, four high-recurrence pointer-like signature classes are not ball physics. Single positive green outcome, missing no-contact controls, non-atomic up to 22 frame brackets. Local 12/12 synthetic tests PASS. Registry retains training.approved=false for all fields. | LABEL PROVENANCE CORRECTION: 2026-10-28 operator disputes the single originally recorded green=yes label; says they do not recall ANY shot landing on the green. Preserve raw entry yes:1/no:10/unknown:0 as original unverified human annotations, but positive outcome is now adjudication=DISPUTED, game-confirmed green landings=0 established; do not infer that its real physical outcome was no. No outcome-specific training or success/failure label until replay or screenshot verification.

limitations: A rendering or UI effect could react to hits without carrying any ball physics variable
Some source windows overlap and alias the SAME guest word; do not count offsets as distinct physical signals
No verified guest-frame atomicity; cannot label exact impact time or vertical velocity
No independently compared no-hit negative and no proof of identical location semantics across runs
required_controls: run the already validated S002 #199 sanitizer over all 11 exact raw/summary pairs
compare per-run recurring source-relative offsets with no-hit/idle controls, deduplicating window aliases
prove source-relative window pointer resolver across fresh boots
obtain frame-anchored ball-object current+cache measurement during independently visible motion
